attributes.long_name: Neighborhood probability of 1 hour precipitation above the 1 hour flash flood guidance depth
attributes.comment: Threshold applies to the preceding 1 hour of accumulation. Neighborhood probability of 1 hour precipitation above the 1 hour flash flood guidance depth. Probabilities compare precipitation with a spatially varying guidance or recurrence-interval depth. Negative values are unavailable thresholds blended into neighboring cells by smoothing; positive values near coverage boundaries can also be biased low. Mask values < -0.1.
